name: ouRSVP – Event RSVP Forms
author: spatidol

sections.description:
ouRSVP is the simplest way to add professional RSVP forms to your WordPress wedding or event website. No coding required!

Features

  • Visual Gutenberg Block – Just add a block and enter your event ID
  • Simple Shortcode – Use [oursvp event_id="your-id"] anywhere
  • Beautiful Forms – Fully customizable forms that match your website
  • Multi-language – Support for English and Spanish
  • Mobile Responsive – Perfect on all devices
  • Guest Management – Manage all responses from your ouRSVP dashboard
  • Zero Configuration – Works instantly after installation

Perfect For

  • Wedding websites
  • Birthday parties
  • Corporate events
  • Baby showers
  • Engagement parties
  • Any event requiring RSVPs

How It Works

  1. Create your event at ouRSVP.app
  2. Customize your RSVP form questions and styling
  3. Install this plugin on your WordPress site
  4. Add the ouRSVP block or shortcode to any page
  5. Enter your event ID
  6. Done! Guests can RSVP directly on your website

Why Choose ouRSVP?

Unlike other RSVP plugins that lock responses inside WordPress, ouRSVP gives you a dedicated dashboard to manage guests, send updates, track dietary restrictions, and more. Your RSVP data stays organized in one place, accessible from anywhere.

Shortcode Attributes

Basic usage:
[oursvp event_id=”abc123″]

With all options:
[oursvp event_id=”abc123″ language=”spanish” show_back_btn=”true” show_full_name=”true” limit_search=”true”]

Attributes:
* event_id (required) – Your ouRSVP event ID
* language (optional) – “english” or “spanish” (default: “english”)
* show_back_btn (optional) – “true” or “false” (default: “false”)
* show_full_name (optional) – “true” or “false” (default: “false”)
* limit_search (optional) – “true” or “false” (default: “false”)

Get Started

Visit ouRSVP.app to create your first event and get your event ID.

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to ouRSVP.app to load RSVP forms and submit guest responses. When users interact with the form, their data is sent to ouRSVP’s servers according to ouRSVP’s privacy policy: https://www.oursvp.app/privacy-policy

No personal data is collected by the plugin itself. All data handling is managed by ouRSVP.app.

External Services

This plugin relies on the following external service:

ouRSVP (https://www.oursvp.app)
* Purpose: Load RSVP forms and store guest responses
* Service URL: https://www.oursvp.app
* Privacy Policy: https://www.oursvp.app/privacy-policy
* Terms of Service: https://www.oursvp.app/terms

The plugin loads JavaScript from:
* https://www.oursvp.app/widget/widget.js

And makes API calls to:
* https://www.oursvp.app/api/forms/[event-id]
* https://www.oursvp.app/api/guests/[form-id]

Support

For help with:
* Plugin installation and setup: Use the WordPress.org support forum
* ouRSVP account and features: Contact support@oursvp.app
* General questions: Visit https://www.oursvp.app

Credits

Developed by the ouRSVP team.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “ouRSVP”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

After Installation

  1. Create an event at ouRSVP.app
  2. Copy your event ID from the dashboard
  3. Add the ouRSVP block to any page, or use the shortcode [oursvp event_id="your-id"]
sections.faq:
Do I need an ouRSVP account?

Yes. You can create an account at ouRSVP.app.

Is ouRSVP free?

ouRSVP costs $5 / month. The WordPress plugin itself is completely free.

Can I customize the form appearance?

Yes! Customize colors, fonts, and styling from your ouRSVP dashboard. Changes appear instantly on your WordPress site.

Can I use multiple forms on my site?

Yes! You can embed different RSVP forms on different pages by using different event IDs.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes! The plugin works with any WordPress theme that supports the block editor (Gutenberg).

Can I use it with page builders?

Yes! Use the shortcode [oursvp event_id="your-id"] in any page builder that supports shortcodes.

Where is my RSVP data stored?

All RSVP responses are securely stored in your ouRSVP account, accessible from your dashboard at ouRSVP.app.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes! The forms are fully responsive and work perfectly on all devices.

Can I export my guest list?

Yes! Export your guest list from your ouRSVP dashboard.

What languages are supported?

Currently English and Spanish. More languages coming soon!

How do I get support?

For plugin issues, use the WordPress.org support forum. For ouRSVP account questions, contact support@oursvp.app.
